text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Why, oh why~?! The lotion isn't soaking in 
at all, though?!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
"Budget makeup is a no-go? No way, we were 
getting along so well up until now..."

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
"You're my partner, right? I only want you 
forever! Come on, get right back onto my 
skin!! Hey!!"

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
A stage just for you♪ Tired of waiting, 
taking damage♪ Waaahhh!!

Because of her rough skin, her toner 
wouldn't absorb properly, leaving Daitaku 
Helios crying out in despair for quite a 
while after.
